metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2025 · When Life Gives You Tangerines
metas.description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs, proving love endures across time.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · House of Guinness
metas.description: Follows the aftermath of the death of brewery mogul, Sir Benjamin Guinness, and the profound impact of his will on the fate of his four adult children: Arthur, Edward, Anne and Ben.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Boots
metas.description: Bullied gay teen Cameron joins the Marine Corps with his best friend despite risks. In boot camp they experience profound personal change amid danger, as their platoon confronts both literal and figurative landmines.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Last Samurai Standing
metas.description: In 1878, 292 samurai gather for a battle royale lured by a 100 thousand yen prize. Wooden tags are given; the last survivor reaching Tokyo wins. Shujiro Saga participates to save his sick family. A dangerous game of survival unfolds.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Death by Lightning
metas.description: Dramatizes the stranger-than-fiction true story of 20th U.S. President James Garfield, and admirer Charles Guiteau, who assassinated him.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Radioactive Emergency
metas.description: In 1987 Brazil, scavengers discover a mysterious glowing substance in an abandoned hospital. As the material changes hands, scientists and doctors desperately work to prevent a radioactive disaster from claiming countless lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Leopard
metas.description: A 19th-century Sicilian aristocratic family gets caught up in the changing sociopolitical times.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The East Palace
metas.description: A king tasks a ghost-slayer and a woman cursed to hear ghosts with uncovering a sinister presence plaguing the crown prince's palace, leading them into a dark realm.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Heweliusz
metas.description: In 1993, the Polish ferry MS Jan Heweliusz capsizes off the coast of Rügen in the Baltic Sea.
